title: Backcasting calibrated monitors: can a safety probe report trustworthy confidence, not just a yes/no?

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Calibration turns a probe into a deployable alarm (plausible chain) but the catastrophic-risk link is indirect.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Linear probe + standard calibration (ECE, temperature scaling); beginner-friendly statistics.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped (calibration measurement + post-hoc fix under shift) with clear metrics.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Open model, no lab access; under-reported calibration work is independent-friendly.

low_compute.reasoning: Inference + linear probe + calibration stats; minimal compute.

novelty.reasoning: Calibration is standard but probe-monitor calibration under shift may be under-reported/open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Calibration is standard but safety-probe calibration under distribution shift may be open.
